input.content: You are a senior PLC control systems architect. Return ONLY valid JSON.

You are a PLC control software architect. Produce a concise architecture plan (at most 2000 words). Do not enumerate exhaustive traces. Return complete JSON with keys:
- state_machine: list of states and transitions
- timer_plan: timers required, PT durations, reset conditions
- priorities: safety and operational priorities
- initial_values: initial values for variables
- scan_execution_order: explicit 4-stage scan order (1. edge sampling, 2. safety/reset priority & state transitions, 3. unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF, 4. unified output assignments)
- formal_assertions: optional list of {"id": "A1", "formula": "G(...)"} temporal/invariant assertions over declared VAR_INPUT/VAR_OUTPUT port names

SPECIFICATIONS:
{
  "id": "PUB004",
  "title": "Jam Pump Debouncing and Runtime Maintenance",
  "difficulty": "easy",
  "requirements": "# Jam Pump Debouncing and Runtime Maintenance\n\n- **Difficulty:** Easy (easy)\n\n## Requirements\n\nControl a jam transfer pump on a food production line, including viscosity-signal debouncing, emergency-stop priority, runtime accumulation and a maintenance-due indication.\n\n1. Accept the viscosity condition only after VISCOSITY_OK has remained TRUE for DebounceTime. Invalidate the condition immediately when the input becomes FALSE.\n2. Allow VFD_RUN to be TRUE only when PASTE_E_STOP_NC is TRUE and the viscosity condition is valid. An emergency stop immediately disables the run output and clears any incomplete debounce timing.\n3. Accumulate PUMP_RUNTIME_ACC using the actual invocation interval CycleTime only while VFD_RUN is TRUE. Preserve the accumulated time while the pump is stopped.\n4. Set PUMP_MAINT_DUE when accumulated runtime reaches 500 hours. This indication is informational and must not affect pump operation or the safety permissive.\n5. At power-up, initialize the run output to OFF, accumulated runtime to zero and the maintenance indication to FALSE.\n\n## Interface Definition\n\n| Direction | Variable/Field | Data Type | Description |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| Input | `VISCOSITY_OK` | `BOOL` | Raw signal indicating that viscosity is within the permitted range. |\n| Input | `PASTE_E_STOP_NC` | `BOOL` | Normally closed emergency-stop circuit; TRUE permits operation and FALSE means emergency stop. |\n| Input | `DebounceTime` | `TIME` | Required continuous valid duration for the viscosity signal; must be positive. |\n| Input | `CycleTime` | `TIME` | Actual elapsed interval represented by this invocation; must be positive. |\n| Output | `VFD_RUN` | `BOOL` | Pump variable-frequency-drive run command. |\n| Output | `PUMP_MAINT_DUE` | `BOOL` | Maintenance indication when accumulated runtime reaches 500 hours. |\n| Output | `PUMP_RUNTIME_ACC` | `LTIME` | Accumulated enabled runtime, using a long-duration time type. |",
  "scenario": "Control a jam transfer pump on a food production line, including viscosity-signal debouncing, emergency-stop priority, runtime accumulation and a maintenance-due indication.",
  "interface": [
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "VISCOSITY_OK",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Raw signal indicating that viscosity is within the permitted range."
    },
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "PASTE_E_STOP_NC",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Normally closed emergency-stop circuit; TRUE permits operation and FALSE means emergency stop."
    },
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "DebounceTime",
      "type": "TIME",
      "description": "Required continuous valid duration for the viscosity signal; must be positive."
    },
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "CycleTime",
      "type": "TIME",
      "description": "Actual elapsed interval represented by this invocation; must be positive."
    },
    {
      "direction": "OUTPUT",
      "name": "VFD_RUN",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Pump variable-frequency-drive run command."
    },
    {
      "direction": "OUTPUT",
      "name": "PUMP_MAINT_DUE",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Maintenance indication when accumulated runtime reaches 500 hours."
    },
    {
      "direction": "OUTPUT",
      "name": "PUMP_RUNTIME_ACC",
      "type": "LTIME",
      "description": "Accumulated enabled runtime, using a long-duration time type."
    }
  ],
  "initial_conditions": {
    "VFD_RUN": false,
    "PUMP_RUNTIME_ACC": "LTIME#0ns",
    "PUMP_MAINT_DUE": false,
    "debounceElapsed_ms": 0
  },
  "scan_semantics": "At scan k, inputs I[k] are sampled once, q[k] is pre-scan retained state, outputs O[k] are observed after execution, and q[k+1] is the updated state. Each test creates a fresh FB instance before step 0. An initialized instance has not yet executed a scan. Timer elapsed time is zero on the first eligible sampled invocation; dt_ms is elapsed wall time since the previous invocation, not automatically a synthetic input to the FB. No unobserved past input stability is assumed. All sequences here are expected values.",
  "safety_priority": [
    "Emergency stop or raw viscosity FALSE clears the run permission immediately.",
    "Maintenance does not override run permission."
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "DebounceTime and CycleTime are strictly positive. Inputs are held stable between timed test samples.",
    "Debouncing follows a TON-style clock: elapsed is zero on the first permitted TRUE sample and becomes valid at elapsed>=DebounceTime.",
    "An E-stop resets debounce validity as well as incomplete timing, so re-enabling requires a full new qualification.",
    "At each invocation, add the supplied CycleTime to the LTIME accumulator iff the end-of-scan VFD_RUN is TRUE. Do not use TIME for the 500-hour accumulator.",
    "PUMP_MAINT_DUE is a level comparison accumulated runtime>=500h and has no reset input. Its threshold case is specified but is not a short practical runtime test.",
    "The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values.",
    "DebounceTime is a strictly positive constant throughout each test case. Dynamic changes are outside this benchmark domain. Time must advance for eventual-start properties.",
    "On timed benchmark tests, CycleTime equals the step dt_ms. Both DebounceTime and CycleTime use exact integer nanoseconds within unsigned 32-bit IEC TIME bounds (<=4294967295 ms), whereas PUMP_RUNTIME_ACC uses 64-bit LTIME (0..2^63-1 ns). Scan k=0 initializes the debounce clock at 0 ms but adds CycleTime to PUMP_RUNTIME_ACC if end-of-scan VFD_RUN is TRUE.",
    "The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values."
  ],
  "ltl": [
    {
      "id": "PUB004.P_init",
      "kind": "safety",
      "formula": "init",
      "description": "Before the first scan invocation, all declared OUTPUT variables and initial instance state hold their declared initial values.",
      "explanation": "Applies strictly to the fresh pre-invocation initial instance observation before scan k=0 (INITIAL_INSTANCE scope).",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "INITIAL_INSTANCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "PUB004.P1",
      "formula": "G(VFD_RUN <-> (permit & qualified))",
      "explanation": "The run output follows the qualified permissive.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "PUB004.P2",
      "formula": "G(!permit -> !VFD_RUN)",
      "explanation": "Raw loss or E-stop stops immediately.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "PUB004.P3",
      "formula": "G((!permit) -> X(!qualified))",
      "explanation": "A lost permissive clears qualification history; future qualification must be rebuilt.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "PUB004.P4",
      "formula": "G(VFD_RUN -> accNext=accPrev+TIME_TO_LTIME(CycleTime))",
      "explanation": "Only enabled intervals are accumulated in a long time type.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "PUB004.P5",
      "formula": "G(!VFD_RUN -> accNext=accPrev)",
      "explanation": "Stopping retains accumulated service time.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "PUB004.P6",
      "formula": "G(PUMP_MAINT_DUE <-> accNext>=LTIME#500h)",
      "explanation": "Maintenance threshold is 500 hours.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "PUB004.P7",
      "formula": "(G(F(TimeTick))) -> (G((G(permit) & DebounceTime>TIME#0ms) -> F(VFD_RUN)))",
      "explanation": "A continuously permitted demand eventually starts under advancing time. Explicit non-Zeno environment premise: physical elapsed time crosses infinitely many 1ms boundaries.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    }
  ],
  "atomic_propositions": {
    "permit": "VISCOSITY_OK & PASTE_E_STOP_NC",
    "qualified": "Continuous permitted raw TRUE duration >= DebounceTime, with first sampled TRUE at elapsed zero.",
    "accPrev": "{\"kind\": \"previous_observed_output\", \"source\": \"O[k-1].PUMP_RUNTIME_ACC\", \"initial\": \"LTIME#0ns\", \"update\": \"After comparing scan k, store ACTUAL O[k].PUMP_RUNTIME_ACC; never write into reference state.\"}",
    "accNext": "O[k].PUMP_RUNTIME_ACC, actual post-scan LTIME; never reference accumulator.",
    "interface names": "Identically named sampled input or end-of-scan output.",
    "TimeTick": "Boolean: floor(t[k]/1ms)>floor(t[k-1]/1ms), with t[0]=0, TimeTick[0]=FALSE, t[k]=sum(dt_ms[1..k]). G(F(TimeTick)) states unbounded physical time progress; merely positive dt is insufficient.",
    "VISCOSITY_OK": "I[k].VISCOSITY_OK: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "PASTE_E_STOP_NC": "I[k].PASTE_E_STOP_NC: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "DebounceTime": "I[k].DebounceTime: sampled input (TIME).",
    "CycleTime": "I[k].CycleTime: sampled input (TIME).",
    "VFD_RUN": "O[k].VFD_RUN: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.",
    "PUMP_MAINT_DUE": "O[k].PUMP_MAINT_DUE: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.",
    "PUMP_RUNTIME_ACC": "O[k].PUMP_RUNTIME_ACC: independently observed post-scan candidate value (LTIME); never defined as expected output.",
    "init": "At the separate pre-invocation initial observation before scan k=0: O_init.VFD_RUN=false, O_init.PUMP_MAINT_DUE=false, O_init.PUMP_RUNTIME_ACC=\"LTIME#0ns\"."
  }
}
